entities.summary: Mihailo Apostolski, also known as Mihail Mitev Apostolov and Mihailo Mitić, was a Macedonian general, partisan, military theoretician, politician, academic and historian. He was the commander of the General Staff of the National Liberation Army and Partisan Detachments of Macedonia, colonel general of the Yugoslav People's Army, and was declared a People's Hero of Yugoslavia.
